name: Grade 6 T2 Practice: June Week 4 - Robot Outputs
description: Practice words for robot outputs and signals.

words.definition: What a device does or shows after a program runs.
words.example: A sound can be an output.
The LED signal showed the robot was finished.

words.definition: A small light on a device or robot.
words.example: The LED turned red when the program started.

words.definition: A small part that makes a sound.
words.example: The buzzer made a short beep.

words.definition: What something is doing or how it is at a moment.
The beginning of an action or program.
words.example: The robot beeped at the start.

words.definition: The end of an action or program.
words.example: The robot flashed an LED at the finish.
